title: Poised for Allostery: Specific Interactions Underlie Precise Positioning of the C-Terminal Tail in Phosphofructokinase-1.
authors: Khodam Hazrati, Mehrnoosh; Nguyen, Truong-An; Timr, Stepan
journal: The journal of physical chemistry. B
one_liner_zh: 该文以人磷酸果糖激酶-1为模型，结合增强采样MD、粗粒化建模和保守性分析，揭示无序C端尾部通过特定氢键和疏水相互作用实现变构定位的机制，属于蛋白质构象采样与变构调控的结构计算研究，与本课题高度相关。
abstract: Disordered terminal segments often regulate enzymes, but how such flexible elements achieve the spatial precision required for allostery remains poorly understood. Using human phosphofructokinase-1 as a model system, we combine enhanced-sampling molecular dynamics simulations, conservation-guided spatial analysis, prior allosteric network analysis, and coarse-grained modeling to show that allosteric positioning of the C-terminal tail, defined by residue-level contacts with the catalytic and regulatory domains, is maintained by a few key hydrogen bonding and hydrophobic interactions. This positioning enables the conserved tail residues L766 and E767 to dynamically couple the tail to the active site through a conserved surface region and to bridge the catalytic and regulatory domains in the T-state, experimentally associated with ATP inhibition. In contrast, coarse-grained simulations lacking explicit directional representation of hydrogen-bonding interactions fail to maintain stable tail docking, whereas including selected OLIVES-derived native hydrogen-bond terms improves the stability of the T-state-like docking pose. These findings support sequence-specific surface docking of a disordered enzyme tail as a physicochemical mechanism for allosteric regulation.
abstract_zh: 无序末端区段常调控酶活性，但此类柔性元件如何实现变构所需的空间精度仍知之甚少。以人磷酸果糖激酶-1为模型系统，我们结合增强采样分子动力学模拟、保守性引导的空间分析、先验变构网络分析及粗粒化建模，表明C末端尾部由残基水平接触催化域和调控域所定义的变构定位，由少数关键氢键和疏水相互作用维持。该定位使保守尾部残基L766和E767通过保守表面区域动态耦合尾部与活性位点，并在T态（实验上与ATP抑制相关）中桥接催化域和调控域。相比之下，缺乏氢键相互作用显式方向表征的粗粒化模拟无法维持稳定的尾部对接，而纳入选定的OLIVES衍生天然氢键项则改善了T态样对接姿态的稳定性。这些发现支持无序酶尾部的序列特异性表面对接作为变构调控的物理化学机制。
